## Audited disposition
Complete negative answer to the literal universal OWR-17471-010 question: claimed_solved, 1/5.

The figure-eight knot is hyperbolic and has no finite nonmeridional surgery. Its zero filling has a metabelian torus-bundle group, so every rank-two free subgroup has a nontrivial second-derived word killed by that filling. The full proof checks every rational finite-surgery possibility using credited classical classification results.

## Scope and credit
The separate existence question, whether at least one hyperbolic knot has a persistent rank-two free subgroup, remains unresolved by this counterexample. The printed April 2026 Question 7.1 is also formally universal; it is not relabeled existential. Classical topology inputs and two source typography defects are disclosed. No novelty or first-priority claim, formal proof-assistant certification, or human peer review is made. OpenAI tools assisted research, drafting and independent review.

## Independent verification
The full independent audit gives PASS with no required mathematical corrections. All frozen author and audit files are preserved exactly. Run `python3 verify_release.py --self-test` from `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004404`.

- Original output reproduces byte-for-byte: 30,625 exact parameter-pair checks
- Independent matrix implementation reproduces byte-for-byte: 10,125 parameter pairs and a non-metabelian negative control
- Safe-only release manifest and both frozen manifests verified
- Four altered-package controls are rejected
- The finite checks support the written universal proof and do not certify topology or novelty

Author manifest SHA256: `4f6575af14a3e8b72e61202c45e411b4febcaa7770c3e7e8af45576eda6218f8`.
Audit manifest SHA256: `b48c8afd46275ecffa62325d34ea5e3c8d68d8a104ee4ce6c3158c024003f72a`.

## Exact change scope
22 portable target files plus one QUEUE.md row. Only this target's Status, Turns and formerly blank Findings cells change; all other queue bytes, including existing links and header metadata, are preserved. Queue was bound to its actual Git blob SHA `c1009ab2e12b93cffb15cb17c0ac893979ce5a44`, on main `bc802f298a58d7f67173cee24af3c87cfd7fdc83`. No state/history rewrite or queue regeneration.

Source PDFs, screenshots, full imported texts, corpora and private coordination material are excluded. Draft PR only; no merge, release, DOI or outreach.
